title: Spicy Brussels Sprout Chips
description: Brussels sprout leaves are tossed in olive oil and Dijon mustard and roasted until crisp for a spicy, delicious twist on veggie chips.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Place a rack in the top third of the oven. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Mix together olive oil, Dijon mustard, sea salt, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl to make sauce.

Trim stems of Brussels sprouts to release outermost leaves, about 5 leaves from each sprout. Reserve cores to roast another time. Place leaves in sauce in the bowl, tossing with your fingers until leaves are evenly coated. Spread leaves on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer.

Roast leaves in the preheated oven until wilted and lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Transfer any crispy leaves to a serving plate; continue roasting, removing crispy leaves every 5 minutes, until all leaves are crispy, about 10 minutes more.

video.description: When you’ve got the craving for crunch but want to avoid the calories, roasted brussels sprouts leaves will deliver! Toss with oil, a little mustard and red pepper and when they’re all crisped up, top them off with some salt and maybe a spritz of juice from a lemon wedge. Fresh from the oven they’re irresistibly snacky—and you can enjoy without the guilt!
